assertion.statement: For the actual permitted imaginary quadratic K and order O_f, Pic(O_f) is the finite-idelic quotient by K* and completed order units; conjugation acts by inversion, split prime Artin symbols are inverse, and adjoining distinct new inert conductor primes gives the full product of cyclic groups of order ell+1.
assertion.objects: The same K, O_f=Z+fO_K, H_f, and ring-class composita used in the fixed E/Q finite Heegner construction.
assertion.hypotheses: K is imaginary quadratic with units exactly plus/minus1; f is prime to2ND_K. Each derivative prime is new, inert and outside6fND_K. K splits at2N when the Q_p conclusion is used.
assertion.quantifiers: Every permitted old conductor f and finite set of distinct new inert primes in this construction.
assertion.parameter_range: The actual untwisted ring-class fields; no arbitrary non-ring-class extension.
assertion.uniformity: One exact construction for all permitted conductors and finite composita; no conductor-dependent multiplier.
assertion.constants: Relative local cyclic factors have exact order ell+1; no bound on class number is needed.
assertion.normalizations: Invertible locally principal order ideals; arithmetic Artin maps; conjugation inversion and unaveraged group operations.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Only invertible locally principal order ideals are used. No splitting of the full class group, nontrivial omitted unit quotient, point norm relation, CM congruence or Kummer descent is inferred.
assertion.limit_order: Fix the actual order and unit subgroup, apply reciprocity/existence, derive local quotient and ramification properties, then consume these in the norm/derivative/local-descent construction.
